import Mathlib

example (x y : ℕ) (hx : x = 2) (hy : y = 3) : x + y = 5 ∧ x * y = 6 := by
  constructor
  · rw [hx, hy]
  · rw [hx, hy]

example (x y : ℕ) (h : x = 2 ∧ y = 3) : x + y = 5 := by
  obtain ⟨hx, hy⟩ := h
  rw [hx, hy]

example (x y : ℕ) (h : x = 2 ∧ y = 3) : x + y = 5 := by
  rw [h.1, h.2]
